claims.claim: Anthropic announced LSVP September 17 as an institutional beta with more permissive biology access.
Standard is team-wide and yearly; High-risk is project-specific, six-month access that removes life-science request blocks while other safeguards remain.
claims.limit: Program design as described by Anthropic.

claims.claim: Anthropic says LSVP shifts biology safeguards toward offline monitoring, with approved use cases and 30-day retention.
claims.limit: Provider description; no independent effectiveness evidence.

claims.claim: Individual plans, third-party platforms and BAA-enabled organizations are not supported at launch.
